Even/odd decomposition gives the exact C2 block L(a,b,p,q)=(a+b,p+Sq+sqrt(2)b*1,p+q), with finite rank coupling to B(p,q)=(p+Sq,p+q). Norm B<=2, while weakly-null high-degree nearly shift-invariant blocks approach 2: essential norm exactly 2. LL* eigen-equations for lambda>4 reduce to a decaying Hardy recurrence v_n=r^n, r=1/(lambda-1), forcing lambda^3-6lambda²+8lambda-4=0; unique root >4 and explicit adjoint eigenvector prove attainment. Independent Python reconstructing the rational extremizer gives squared output/input quotient 4.382975767906236, within 4e-15 of the root. Finite calculation checks arithmetic only; the operator-theoretic proof establishes the infinite claim.
